name: LAYING_ON_OF_HANDS
canonical: the fully-robed high priest in the tabernacle court pressing both of his hands down firmly upon the head of a standing live goat, the solemn transfer of confessed guilt onto the animal — reverent and modest, everyone fully clothed in priestly robes, NO nudity, nothing suggestive, no bare bodies
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
